scope: All deployed or release-gate Python outside test files
rule: Every production Python file must have one bounded responsibility and direct test evidence; unlisted code fails CI.

files.responsibility: Reject current, untracked, symlinked, and reachable-history secrets or personal-state leakage before public release.
files.why_separate: Repository publication is a distinct destructive/privacy boundary.

files.responsibility: Reject reference-deployment contamination inside the portable starter boundary.
files.why_separate: Starter privacy has a narrower scope and blocklist than whole-repository publication.

files.responsibility: Render project instructions atomically from validated non-secret configuration.
files.why_separate: Bootstrap rendering is an install-time transaction, not runtime policy.

files.responsibility: Generate and validate the hierarchical JSON/Markdown catalog from the forensic feature ledger.
files.why_separate: Release-status bookkeeping is a repository gate, not personal mutable state.

files.responsibility: Normalize historical route evidence into unique reusable terminal-pair knowledge without fabricated trip history.
files.why_separate: One-time evidence import has different inputs and mutation authority from brief runtime.

files.responsibility: Compute the content-sensitive public skill fingerprint while excluding tests and the private deployment locator.
files.why_separate: Deployment integrity must be independently reproducible by CI and installers.

files.responsibility: Enforce cross-file release, scheduling, authority, onboarding, policy, and schema invariants.
files.why_separate: Cross-document coherence is broader than any individual module test.

files.responsibility: Resolve composable roles, context recommendations, explicit service states, and respectful reminder templates.
files.why_separate: Portable first boot cannot depend on the reference deployment runtime.

files.responsibility: Resolve portable onboarding readiness from observed runtime, source, state, evidence, scheduling, and organizational approval capabilities.
files.why_separate: Provider capability and regulated-data gates are deployment concerns independent from life-profile and service routing.

files.responsibility: Validate portable feature manifests, schemas, file boundaries, dependencies, and honest delivery claims.
files.why_separate: Shared-feature isolation is a portable-source release boundary.

files.responsibility: Reconcile provenance, namespaced identifiers, manuals, knowledge links, specifications, lookup work, and bidirectional asset/receipt queries.
files.why_separate: Evidence/knowledge/specification records have independent authorities and failure semantics from physical asset creation.

files.responsibility: Determine bounded refund/reversal follow-up deadlines in business days.
files.why_separate: Deadline policy is independent from charge matching and avoids entangling financial states.

files.responsibility: Create immutable assets from included receipt lines and reconcile explicit UUID relationships idempotently.
files.why_separate: Physical asset identity is the source transaction before evidence/manual projections.

files.responsibility: Resolve canonical-time entry, HOME/ROAD state, trips, tasks, appointments, mileage/pay, and deterministic Run Log/brief output.
files.why_separate: This is the sole cohesive brief-state reducer; duplicate wrappers are prohibited.

files.responsibility: Match expected charges to pending/posted debit-credit evidence using exact-cent arithmetic.
files.why_separate: Settlement matching has different evidence and transitions from refund deadlines.

files.responsibility: Reduce order/carrier evidence into active package fulfillment with authority priority, cancellations, and replacements.
files.why_separate: Active fulfillment is a projection, not canonical transaction/asset history.

files.responsibility: Plan deterministic appointment and evidence-confirmed medication reminders for provider projection without task fan-out.
files.why_separate: Reminder timing and health-safety consent are independent from brief rendering and Calendar adapters.
